title: Where we're going, we don't need roads. Go find the edges.
alt: A DeLorean lifting off a winding road into a starfield of AI network nodes, captioned Where we're going, we don't need roads. Thinking outside the box in the new world of AI
notes: 3:29. The walk-out slide. Leave it up. After the thank-you, click to this and stop talking. Let the picture and the line do the last thirty seconds while people stand up. Nothing to add, nothing to explain. If someone comes to the front with a question, this is what is behind you while you answer it. Contact details are on it so anyone who missed the close slide still has a way to find you.
